description: Score how well a résumé will pass the applicant tracking system for a specific job. Returns the score plus the per-category breakdown, keyword analysis, and concrete fixes. Uses one unit of the monthly ATS allowance. Pass generated_resume_id to score a tailored résumé rather than a stored one.

force.description: Regenerate even if a result already exists, or if the match score is low. Spends allowance. Only set this when the user asks.

generated_resume_id.description: Score a tailored résumé produced by tailor_resume instead of a stored one.

resume_id.description: Which stored résumé to use. Omit to use the default. Call list_my_resumes to see the options.

name: check_ats_score
title: Score a résumé against a job's ATS
